light.bake_drop_interior_why: proxy faces with solid on both sides (inner shells under the layered scale plates) left out of the bake source so the cage stays tight
light.uv_island_margin_why: the plate low unwraps into thousands of islands; margin 0.001 keeps the atlas texel coverage up (vulture_creature lesson)
